name: Braelyn Firehand
label: Character
description: At Sun Rock Retreat, Braelyn Firehand lives among the Horde and draws travelers into a campaign against the night elves of Stonetalon Peak.
intro: At Sun Rock Retreat, Braelyn Firehand lives among the Horde and draws travelers into a campaign against the night elves of Stonetalon Peak.

p: At Sun Rock Retreat, Braelyn Firehand is a blood elf living openly among tauren lodges and orcish tents. The retreat’s shamans and chieftains tolerate her, apparently unaware of her true loyalties. She calls herself an observer of the region’s magic and hires passing Horde mercenaries for dangerous work among the crags.
